config.runeheart.general.debug_log.toolt: true = writes what Runeheart is doing to latest.log (marker [Runeheart]), to investigate problems
config.runeheart.visual.show_hud.tooltip: Show the natural mana gauge while Mana Sense is active
msg.runeheart.nm_disabled: Natural mana is turned off on this server.
msg.runeheart.nm_parts: Biome: %s (base %s) · vegetation +%s · flowing water +%s · buildings -%s · storm +%s · already drawn -%s
msg.runeheart.nm_drained: Drew %s natural mana from this chunk.
msg.runeheart.nm_refilled: This chunk's natural mana is full again.
config.runeheart.natural_mana.regen_seco: Seconds for a drained chunk to refill completely
config.runeheart.natural_mana.rescan_sec: How often a chunk's vegetation and buildings are counted again
config.runeheart.natural_mana.vegetation: Density added by a chunk covered in vegetation (leaves, logs, flowers, plants)
config.runeheart.natural_mana.water_bonu: Density added when the chunk has flowing water or a waterfall
config.runeheart.natural_mana.building_p: Density removed from a chunk taken over by buildings (bricks, planks, glass, iron, redstone)
config.runeheart.visual.hud_x.tooltip: Distance from the left edge of the screen, in GUI pixels
config.runeheart.visual.hud_y.tooltip: Distance from the top of the screen, in GUI pixels
config.runeheart.visual.particles.toolti: Show glowing pollen in the air where natural mana is high
config.runeheart.visual.particle_thresho: Density from which the particles appear
msg.runeheart.abs_disabled: Absorption is turned off on this server.
msg.runeheart.abs_no_mana_stats: Could not read your Block Clover mana.
msg.runeheart.abs_not_attuned: You cannot sense natural mana yet: stand still with Mana Sense on in a place with density %s or more.
msg.runeheart.abs_broken_move: Focus broken: you moved. Release and hold the key again.
msg.runeheart.abs_broken_hurt: Focus broken: you took damage. Release and hold the key again.
msg.runeheart.abs_overload: Overload! This place is too dry (natural mana %s).
msg.runeheart.attune_too_dry: This place is too dry to sense natural mana (%s; needs %s).
msg.runeheart.attune_done: You sense the natural mana around you. Hold the focus key while standing still to absorb it.
msg.runeheart.attune_status: Attunement: %s/%s s. Stand still with Mana Sense on in a place with density %s or more.
msg.runeheart.attune_status_done: You already sense natural mana and can absorb it.
config.runeheart.absorption.mana_percent: Mana regained per second at density 100, as a percentage of max mana. Scales down with density (density 50 = half)
config.runeheart.absorption.natural_cost: How much the chunk's density drops per second of absorption (while the player's mana is filling)
config.runeheart.absorption.overload_bel: Below this density, focusing gives no mana: it causes nausea and damage
config.runeheart.absorption.move_toleran: How far the player may move per tick (in blocks) without breaking focus
config.runeheart.absorption.require_attu: true = before absorbing, the player must 'sense natural mana': stand still with Mana Sense on in a dense place
config.runeheart.absorption.attunement_s: Seconds (added up, not necessarily in a row) standing still with Mana Sense on in a dense place to learn absorption
config.runeheart.absorption.attunement_d: Minimum density for attunement to progress
